tagline: Decoding immune systems through single-cell, spatial, and TCR computation.
positioning: Lab W develops single-cell and spatial omics technologies, computational TCR immunology methods, and integrative multi-omics frameworks to decode immune states, T cell recognition, and autoimmune disease mechanisms.
description: Lab W develops computational and experimental frameworks for single-cell and spatial omics, TCR repertoire analysis, and autoimmune disease systems biology.
